name: why-academy
description: A free, open-source interactive learning platform that teaches STEM through a derive-it-yourself methodology. Students perform stepwise algebraic derivations, estimate answers in scientific notation, implement solutions in code, and explain concepts — all verified deterministically. No AI grading, no paywall.

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply why-academy --local -c worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply why-academy --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml
